description: Sets the engine ships, in printing order. The single registry of the card pool: the web app, test fixtures, and scripts all read this instead of keeping their own copies of the list. Add a set by ingesting it (scripts/ingest_set.py) and appending an entry here.
measured_description: Sets ingested for measurement but NOT shipped: the coverage instruments (scripts/hook_reliance.py, scripts/grammar_coverage.py) read them, and nothing else does. `sets` above is what the engine plays, and it stays 100% supported — the web app offers those cards to players and two guards assert every one of them compiles as supported. A set lands here first so its numbers can be read before the work of supporting it is done, and moves up to `sets` when it is fully supported. Keeping them in one file rather than two is deliberate: the roles differ, the registry does not.
